messages:
Aria: Quick postmortem from the partner canary: we saw a flood of fncall schema errors. Many were harmless (extra optional keys) but all counted as rejects. Users are confused.
Diego: Are those the strict-validator rejects we enabled last week?
Aria: Yes. Strict mode currently returns a 400 and increments fncall_reject_total. We also have a soft-path that tags responses with validation=soft and still serves the output, but we weren't emitting separate metrics for that path.
Nora: Two immediate asks: 1) split metrics so admins can see soft vs hard; 2) make sampled raw payloads available for deep-dive without increasing Prom label cardinality.
Kai: For (1) let's add fncall_validation_total{outcome="ok|soft|hard"} as a low-cardinality label. That reduces risk for Prom.
Diego: For (2) emit a stable reason_id (short hash) + sample_id in the event index. Leave full textual reason only in trace/log storage. That way metrics have small labels, and SRE can click through.
Aria: Agreed. Also billing needs a separate counter for soft_degraded_tokens so product can show customers a split.
Nora: Implementation plan idea: router tags route_id and integration_id as before. Exporter maps detailed validation -> (outcome, reason_id). Sampler does stratified sampling by integration_id so heavy partners don't drown out others.
Kai: Stratified sampler config: default reservoir 2000 events/hour per integration, adjustable by plan. We'll expose a flag to enable per-route stratify=true.
Diego: Concern: adding integration_id to sampling key is fine, but please don't put integration_id as a label on Prom metrics. Use it only in sampling/trace events.
Aria: UX: dashboard should show three time series: ok, soft, hard, plus a stacked area for soft_degraded_served tokens. Add a heatmap of (route, outcome) pairs and a sample-rate overlay.
Nora: Also add an event stream panel with a quick filter by reason_id so engineers can find examples. Each event links to the raw sampled payload in the sample index.
Kai: Rollout proposal: 48h permissive canary emitting only coarse outcome labels + sampling. Then enable strict validation for 5% traffic with auto-fallback threshold: if hard_rate > 0.25% sustained for 10m, rollback to previous flag.
Diego: Can feature-flag runner accept a metric-driven rollback? ops-bot?
ops-bot: Flag-runner supports webhook-triggered rollbacks. Recommend alert rule in Prometheus: alert if rate(fncall_validation_total{outcome="hard"}[10m]) / rate(fncall_validation_total[10m]) > 0.002 => call flag-runner rollback API.
Aria: Cool. Add audit annotation to the rollback event so we can trace who/what triggered it.
Nora: One more: sampling bias. If we sample uniformly we miss rare reasons. Suggest we reserve N slots/day for low-volume customers (min_reservoir per customer) so dev teams can still surface odd bugs.
Kai: We'll implement hybrid reservoir: stratified by integration_id with floor of 10 events/day for any customer with non-zero traffic. Configured via sampler service.
Diego: Metrics change owners? I'll take exporter and billing tag. Kai take sampler. Nora take dashboard. Aria coordinate rollout and customer comms.
Aria: I'll draft a customer-facing note template summarizing what changed and how billing will show soft-degraded tokens. @metrics-bot can you create the dashboard PR stub?
metrics-bot: Created dashboard PR: https://internal.dash/redwood/PR-482  panels added: fncall_validation (ok/soft/hard), soft_degraded_tokens.
Diego: Billing ingestion contract: we need a new field billing_category=soft_degraded on usage events. I'll open a follow-up with finance.
Nora: DevEx please add runbook docs (how to interpret outcome labels, how to request re-sample) so SOC and SRE know steps.
Kai: Timeline: exporter PR today, sampler change tomorrow, dashboard updates within 48h. Start permissive canary Friday 00:00 UTC.
Aria: Thanks. If anyone sees unexpected spikes after the exporter ship, ping oncall and I'll pause the rollout.
ops-bot: deploy queued: eng-platform/exporter#250  awaiting reviews.
Diego: ping reviewers  trying to get this in before EOD so we can start canary Friday.
